text: うみの　ポケモンは　ふかい　ところに　いるから　つりざおで　つり　あげるんだ！

structure.jp: うみの　ポケモンは
ふかい　ところに　いるから
つりざおで　つり　あげるんだ！
structure.en: you fish them up with a rod!

patterns.name: 〜から (reason)
patterns.explanation: から after a statement gives it as the reason for what comes next. ふかい　ところに　いるから = 'because they are in deep places'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing shows the tool you use to do something. つりざおで = 'with a fishing rod'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end gives the line an explaining, 'here's how it works' tone. つり　あげるんだ = 'you fish them up, you see'.
